panels.title: Nodes Ready
panels.description: Number of Kubernetes nodes in Ready state, from `kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}`. All nodes should be ready for normal cluster operation.

panels.title: Nodes Not Ready
panels.description: Number of nodes NOT in Ready state, from `kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="false"}`. Non-zero indicates node problems.

panels.title: Total Pods
panels.description: Total number of pods known to the cluster (all phases), from `kube_pod_info`. Includes running, pending, failed, etc.

panels.title: Running Pods
panels.description: Number of pods in Running phase, from `kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"}`. Should be close to total pods in a healthy cluster.

panels.title: Total Deployments
panels.description: Total number of Deployment resources in the cluster, from `kube_deployment_labels`.

panels.title: Deployments Ready
panels.description: Number of Deployments with Available condition true, from `kube_deployment_status_condition{condition="Available", status="true"}`. These are serving their intended replicas.

panels.title: Total Namespaces
panels.description: Total number of namespaces in the cluster, from `kube_namespace_labels`.

panels.title: Total Services
panels.description: Total number of Service resources, from `kube_service_labels`.

panels.title: Pod Status by Phase
panels.description: Breakdown of pods by phase (Running, Pending, Failed, Succeeded, Unknown), from `kube_pod_status_phase` by (phase). Gives a quick health picture of the workload. Running should dominate; Pending means pods are waiting for scheduling or resources; Failed means pods have crashed.

panels.title: Pod Restarts by Namespace
panels.description: Pod container restarts in the last hour, grouped by namespace, from `increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[1h])` by (namespace). Spikes indicate unstable workloads — pods that are crashing or being evicted repeatedly.

panels.title: Node CPU Utilization %
panels.description: Average CPU utilization across all nodes, calculated as 100 - idle%, from `node_cpu_seconds_total` (idle mode). From node_exporter.

panels.title: Node Memory Utilization %
panels.description: Average memory usage percentage across all nodes, from `node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes` vs `node_memory_MemTotal_bytes`. From node_exporter.

panels.title: Container CPU Usage by Namespace
panels.description: CPU consumption by namespace from container metrics, from `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total` by (namespace). Excludes empty container names.

panels.title: Container Memory Usage by Namespace
panels.description: Memory consumption by namespace from container metrics, from `container_memory_working_set_bytes` by (namespace).

panels.title: Deployments Ready vs Desired
panels.description: Deployments with Available condition true vs total desired replicas, by namespace, from `kube_deployment_status_condition{condition="Available", status="true"}` and `kube_deployment_spec_replicas` by (namespace). Shows where deployments are fully available and where they are under-replicated.

panels.title: Persistent Volume Usage %
panels.description: Storage usage percentage for persistent volume claims, calculated as 1 - (available / capacity), from `kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes` and `kube_persistentvolume_status_capacity_bytes`.
